caption: The drawing depicts a pair of shoes placed next to each other, both oriented toward the right side of the image. The shoes have a dark gray, almost black upper with a matte texture. They feature prominent gold-colored rectangular buckles on the tops, each situated on a strap that crosses over the shoe’s upper. The shoes have a distinct, squared toe and a slightly raised tongue. The soles and interiors are a lighter beige or off-white color. Each shoe has a medium-height, blocky heel that is colored red. The background is a plain, light beige color without additional details or objects.
title: Shoes
